## Phasing

```{r whatshap-info}
whatshap = SECTION_DATA[["whatshap"]]
if (is.null(whatshap)) {
  section_notice("WhatsHap phasing statistics not found.")
}
```

```{r whatshap-table}
if (!is.null(whatshap) && nrow(whatshap$per_chrom) > 0) {
  show_cols = c("chromosome", "variants", "heterozygous_variants", "phased", "unphased",
                "singletons", "blocks", "phased_fraction", "bp_per_block_median",
                "block_n50")
  show_cols = show_cols[show_cols %in% names(whatshap$per_chrom)]

  wt = whatshap$per_chrom[, ..show_cols]
  if ("phased_fraction" %in% names(wt)) {
    wt[, phased_fraction := round(phased_fraction * 100, 1)]
    setnames(wt, "phased_fraction", "phased%")
  }

  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::p(
      htmltools::tags$em(
        sprintf("Germline phasing statistics, from %s.",
                if (!is.na(whatshap$vcf)) whatshap$vcf else "the phased germline VCF")
      )
    ),
    DT::datatable(
      wt,
      rownames    = FALSE,
      filter      = "top",
      extensions  = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
      options     = list(
        dom         = "Bfrtip",
        buttons     = c("copy", "csv"),
        scrollX     = TRUE,
        scrollY     = "350px",
        scroller    = TRUE,
        deferRender = TRUE,
        pageLength  = 25,
        columnDefs  = list(list(className = "dt-left", targets = "_all"))
      )
    )
  )
}
```
